sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 392 (per-loop search + campsitePaging.do over loops A, B, C, D, E, F, W; all 129 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Arrive by 9 pm; six people and one vehicle per site, no guests or visitors.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/beaver-pond-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=392 (Booking Window 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'If you make your reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'; 'Reservation check-ins must arrive before 9PM'; 'Campsite occupancy is limited to six (6) persons'; 'Only one (1) vehicle is permitted at each campsite'; 'Guests and visitors are not permitted'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 129 campsites in sections A-F and W, all back-in; 62 are platforms. Only 7 are listed for a 30-ft rig (D Road 2, 4, 6; E Road 3, 4, 20; F Road 3); 6 W Section sites are listed at 20 ft, the rest carry no length.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/beaver-pond-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=392 ('Campsite (129)'; 'tent and trailer sites, as well as accommodations for larger vehicles') + ReserveAmerica site list (Equip length/Driveway '30 Back-In' 7, '20 Back-In' 6, 'Back-In' 116; 62 sites named '- Platform'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 392 (all 129 campsites 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/beaver-pond-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=392 ('Comfort stations, showers, laundry facilities, and a dumping station are part of the campground'; Services and Amenities 'Water Fillup Station'), read 2026-10-21

note: Palisades Interstate Park Commission campground in Harriman State Park, beside the Lake Welch beach; mostly tent and platform sites. No pets on any site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 392): reservable, phone 845-947-2792, 2027 season Apr 16 - Oct 10 with Section A May 21 - Sep 5 (matches), no electric, 7 sites listed at 30 ft (so a 23-ft rig fits, by reservation). Changed site count 135 -> 129 (62 platforms). Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, all back-in, showers/laundry/dump/water fill. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note trimmed of counts/hookups/length/booking text (the 73 tent + 55 platform split is not what RA sells).
flags: Criteria margin: only 7 of 129 campsites take a 23-ft rig (listed '30 Back-In': D Road 2, 4, 6; E Road 3, 4, 20; F Road 3); all are reservable on ReserveAmerica. Every site is listed 'Pets Allowed - no'.
